baseline_models.focus_anchor: جزاؤهم، عند ربهم، and the reciprocal رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus begins with act-matching recompense but locates it in the recipients' Lord's presence and culminates in reciprocal consent. The gardens are therefore one component of a relationship brought into accepted alignment, not the whole content of the reward.

activation_trace.role: Matching an act with its recompense supplies the act-to-outcome correspondence that opens the model.
Proximity and presence place the recompense with their Lord rather than treating it as a detached asset.
Nurture and completion make the repeated Lord-relation the agency that brings the recipients and their outcome to completion.
Reciprocal satisfaction supplies the two-way acceptance that turns recompense into relational settlement.

changed_reading.before: Their reward is principally a unilateral payment consisting of gardens.
changed_reading.after: Their reward is a Lord-held settlement in which fitting recompense, habitation, divine acceptance, and their answering acceptance form one reciprocal outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جنات عدن تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden is a tree-covered, vigorously growing enclosure whose lower level carries opened watercourses and ongoing provision. Lordly nurture and the paired duration terms make it a continuously sustained habitat rather than a static scenic prize.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered enclosure gives the garden its sheltered spatial form.
Thick vigorous plant growth makes the enclosure productive and living rather than merely decorative.
Ongoing provision turns the grammatical flow into the habitat's continuing supply mechanism.
The literal lower side locates the sustaining movement beneath the inhabited garden.
Opening and widening until flow can pass supplies the channels that keep the garden watered.
Stagewise nurture and completion assign maintenance of this living system to the Lord-relation.
Enduring permanence keeps the supplied habitat from running down or passing away.
Emphatic duration extends the maintained condition without a terminal horizon.

changed_reading.before: The verse displays an everlasting garden landscape.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents a protected, cultivated habitat whose hidden flow, growth, provision, and Lordly maintenance remain continuously operative.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing qualification can hold knowledge and reverent fear together: apprehension of the Lord's authority and nurture becomes awe, so eligibility is a knowing orientation rather than raw fright.

activation_trace.role: The figurative knowledge branch supplies cognitive apprehension to the closing qualification.
Fear joined with awe converts apprehension into a reverent affective stance.
Lordship and authority identify what is known and revered, anchoring the stance in ربه.

changed_reading.before: The reward belongs to whoever is simply afraid of the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The reward belongs to one whose apprehension of the Lord's authority has become reverent, responsive awe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah holds unbinding in suspension until disclosure arrives. Against that release axis, the focus ayah's clinging permanence and presence with the Lord read as a settled attachment reached on the far side of disclosed evidence.

activation_trace.role: Clinging and staying close supply the focus state that the context's unbinding axis recasts as settled attachment.
Presence at the Lord gives that settled attachment a relational location.
Opening what is closed and separating what is entangled supplies the release pole against which focus permanence is reread.
Emergence and disclosure make the bayyina the contextual threshold after which attachment can be evaluated.

structural_cues: 98:1 suspends the negated state of being unbound with حتى until the bayyina arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suspended unbinding, disclosure, focus clinging, and presence; I infer a movement from unresolved attachment to evidence-sealed belonging. A live alternative is that 98:1 only marks the timing of cessation and has no attachment mechanism for 98:8.

changed_reading.after: Abiding also reads as a definitive, disclosed-evidence-tested attachment in the Lord's presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purified written surfaces lead into writings that can establish a binding determination and are described through uprightness. These cues activate the debt-settlement branch of جزاء, making the focus reward readable as execution of a clean, upright record rather than an unannounced favor.

activation_trace.role: Collecting or settling a due gives the focus recompense a dischargeable-account form.
Presence and rank at the Lord locate the settlement at its authoritative source.
The written-sheet image supplies a public, readable carrier for what precedes the focus judgment.
Purity as removal of stain qualifies that carrier as uncontaminated.
Writing that establishes an obligating judgment supplies the record-to-verdict function.
Straightness and equilibrium characterize the recorded determination as upright.

structural_cues: 98:2-3 move from recited purified sheets to the writings contained in them and described as qayyima.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written carriers, purity, binding inscription, uprightness, and a focus due; I infer that the record is executed as recompense. The live alternative is that the writings regulate conduct but do not function as a judgment record.

changed_reading.before: The gardens arrive as a reward whose adjudicative path is unstated.
changed_reading.after: The gardens and reciprocal approval read as the openly executed settlement of an uncontaminated, upright record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places division after the clear disclosure has arrived. That sequence blocks a reduction of خشي to information possessed: its knowledge branch must remain joined to awe, because exposure to clarity can still issue in fragmentation rather than the focus ayah's qualifying response.

activation_trace.role: Knowing as a figurative sense supplies the informational component whose sufficiency the context tests.
Reverent fear supplies the responsive orientation that distinguishes khashya from bare reception of evidence.
Scattering into parts supplies the adverse response that follows disclosure.
Arrival fixes the bayyina as already present before the division occurs.
Disclosure and emergence establish that what arrived was manifest rather than hidden.

structural_cues: 98:4 explicitly orders communal division after the bayyina came to its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest arrival followed by division and focus khashya's knowledge and awe branches; I infer that awe names a response to knowledge rather than knowledge alone. A live alternative is that خشي remains simple fear and the contextual sequence only distinguishes groups.

changed_reading.before: Whoever knows or recognizes the Lord qualifies for the reward.
changed_reading.after: The qualifier is recognition converted into reverent response; manifest information by itself can precede division and does not satisfy the focus condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accounting and valuation cues establish a due, while giving and increase redirect that due toward expansion. Joined to the focus branches of debt settlement and ongoing provision, the reward becomes an account whose closure opens into an inexhaustibly continuing grant.

activation_trace.role: Demanding and settling a debt supplies the closing of an account at the focus.
Continuing provision prevents settlement from becoming a one-time exhausted payment.
Accounting and recompense supply the context's explicit ledger-like frame.
Valuation and appraisal supply a measure by which the due can be assessed.
Giving turns assessed obligation into an outward transfer.
Growth and increase make the transfer productive rather than merely subtractive.

structural_cues: 98:5 coordinates religion, establishing, giving, and increase before 98:8 names the recipients' recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, valuation, giving, increase, debt settlement, and continuing provision; I supply the arrow by which a settled due becomes an expanding grant. A live alternative is that the 98:5 terms describe obligations only and do not model the reward's mode of delivery.

changed_reading.before: Recompense closes an account with a finite equivalent.
changed_reading.after: Recompense closes what is due yet opens it into continuing, increasing provision, so settlement does not exhaust the gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same abiding construction attaches to fire in 98:6 and gardens in 98:8. Permanence is therefore not independently the reward; it intensifies whatever habitat and relation holds the person, while garden, provision, and reciprocal approval make the focus condition desirable.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the positive habitat to which focus permanence attaches.
Enduring permanence supplies a duration shared with the opposing contextual outcome.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure gives the focus permanence its positive relational quality.
Kindled fire supplies the opposing habitat in which the same duration construction appears.
Enduring permanence on the fire side proves that duration alone is not a positive value.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:8 repeat خالدين فيها across fire and gardens, changing the containing habitat while retaining the duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel abiding constructions in opposed habitats; I infer that permanence is a neutral amplifier and that habitat plus relation determine its value. A live alternative is that the repetition only emphasizes equal endlessness without inviting functional decomposition.

changed_reading.before: Eternal duration is itself the central reward.
changed_reading.after: Eternal duration fixes attachment; the reward lies in what one is fixed within and in the reciprocal acceptance that characterizes that condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context supplies both the wage of intentional work and generosity or gift under خير. The focus matching-recompense branch supports earned correspondence, while its continuing provision exceeds a closed wage, preserving reward as both fitted return and generous grant.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense supplies the earned-correspondence side of the reward.
Ongoing grant supplies an excess beyond a wage that would be paid and exhausted.
The wage or provision of a worker makes intentional deeds legible in an earned-payment register.
Generosity and gift activate a simultaneous non-wage register for the same focus outcome.

structural_cues: 98:7 places intentional work and خير immediately before 98:8 names recompense and depicts continuing flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work-wage, generosity-gift, matching recompense, and ongoing provision; I let both registers qualify one outcome. A live alternative is that خير is only comparative goodness here and contributes no gift mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The outcome must be classified either as wages earned by deeds or as an unearned gift.
changed_reading.after: The outcome holds both registers: it fittingly answers intentional work yet arrives as a generous provision whose flow is not exhausted by equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inward security and the removal of estrangement in 98:7 feed directly into the focus ayah's reciprocal satisfaction and settled inward state. Reward can thus be read as repaired relation becoming mutually acceptable and internally at rest.

activation_trace.role: Mutual consent supplies the reciprocal relational endpoint of the repair.
A thought settled in the heart gives the enduring outcome an inward resting dimension.
Security and trust that quiet the heart supply the inward condition leading toward settled satisfaction.
Reconciliation that removes estrangement supplies the relational repair completed by mutual رضا.

structural_cues: 98:7's faith-and-repair sequence immediately precedes 98:8's two-directional رضي ... ورضوا construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quiet trust, reconciliation, mutual consent, and inward settling; I infer a causal movement from repaired orientation to reciprocal rest. A live alternative is that صالحات denotes fitting deeds without activating interpersonal reconciliation.

changed_reading.before: Approval is a verdict added after reward has been delivered.
changed_reading.after: Approval is the completion of a repaired relation: estrangement has yielded to mutual consent, and the beneficiaries' inward state has settled with it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ج ز ز target in the split mapping for focus جزاء, not the dominant recompense root. It remains anchored to word 1 and gains visible support from the focus garden's vigorous growth and Lordly nurture. Downstream prose should mark it as a form-distant lexical echo, never as the derivation or primary sense of جزاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جزاؤهم beside جنات and the repeated رب relation

activation_trace.role: Readiness for cutting or harvest supplies a form-distant image of recompense arriving when cultivated growth has matured.
Vigorous intertwined growth gives the harvest echo a concrete focus-domain substrate.
Stagewise nurture and completion provide the developmental path by which growth reaches readiness.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is transferred after the relevant acts are complete.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense resembles a harvest at ripeness: Lordly cultivation reaches completion and its mature yield becomes the garden outcome.

strongest_changes: Because خالدين فيها governs both fire and gardens, permanence becomes a neutral fixing of attachment; garden, provision, and reciprocal رضا determine the focus outcome's positive value.
Because manifest evidence is followed by division, خشي ربه cannot be reduced to possessing knowledge; it is recognition converted into reverent response.
Record, account, wage, gift, and growth cues make جزاء an inspectable settlement while its continuing flow keeps that settlement from collapsing into a finite transaction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah interlocks three mechanisms usually flattened into one reward image: a maintained habitat, an enduring attachment, and a reciprocal Lord-human acceptance. Context separates those mechanisms and shows that duration alone is not value, information alone is not khashya, and equivalence alone does not exhaust the gift.
remaining_uncertainties: The move from purified writings to an executed judgment record is reader-supplied; the packet also permits the writings to function only as conduct-guiding prescriptions.
The continuing-provision branch of ج ر ي productively changes the rivers into a supply mechanism, but literal water flow remains the nearer reading.
The harvest model depends on the non-dominant ج ز ز mapping and must remain an exploratory lexical echo.
